frontier_act_119.text: I signed a letter asking Speaker Johnson to keep Congress in session until AI regulations are written. I have also signed onto two bills aimed at requiring a kill switch and the FRONTIER Act, which will require third party auditors. I also support a Select Committee on AI that would address safety, minimize job losses, and make sure Americans have the skills and safety net for this transition.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says he signed onto the FRONTIER Act.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names the FRONTIER Act and says he signed onto it.

china_race_dynamics.text: AI could bring enormous benefits, from medical research and drug development to practical fixes like addressing bus bunching. It also carries real risks, and even the CEOs of AI companies acknowledge that humans could lose control of the technology. I disagree with the Trump Administration’s hands-off approach. We are being presented with a false choice between “winning the race with China” and protecting the American people. We can and must do both.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the US can and must both win the race with China and protect Americans.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly rejects a false choice and endorses both competition and protection.

china_race_dynamics.text: The House should also push for a standing AI dialogue with China, so safety incidents can be shared quickly and trust built over time. America can compete with China and protect people at the same time.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls for AI dialogue with China and says America can compete while protecting people.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly endorses cooperation and safety alongside competition, but does not explicitly call competition a priority.
